task: Build an end-to-end G5-05 Map/Set scaling proof across Fast Debug, native release and Margo Bench.
observation: On staged ABI-v10 before the worker optimization, Fast Debug uses vector-backed Map/Set lookup and grows 69.33x when an exact-output workload increases 10x (1,000 to 10,000 keys).
impact: The frozen benchmark gate remains red; accepting only correctness or native runtime tests would hide quadratic Fast Debug behavior.
evidence: python3 tests/benchmarks/phase25_benchmarks.py: G5-05 Fast Debug 10x Map/Set workload grew 69.33x (0.116900s -> 8.104803s), expected <= 30.0x
src/interpreter.hpp: Value::map_value and Value::set_value store vectors

resolution.summary: The sole L4 compiler writer is adding staged-v10 hash-bucket side indexes while retaining snapshot order and v9 behavior. Rerun the benchmark on the combined clean head before gate promotion.
